files_update_entry.text: UPDATE "nodestro_files" SET entry = %(entry)s::jsonb WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND id = %(id)s

files_upsert.text: INSERT INTO "nodestro_files" (tenant_id, namespace, id, entry, data) VALUES (%(tenant_id)s, %(namespace)s, %(id)s, %(entry)s::jsonb, %(data)s) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, namespace, id) DO UPDATE SET entry = excluded.entry, data = excluded.data

files_entry.text: SELECT entry::text FROM "nodestro_files" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND id = %(id)s

files_data.text: SELECT data FROM "nodestro_files" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND id = %(id)s

files_entries.text: SELECT entry::text FROM "nodestro_files" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s

files_delete.text: DELETE FROM "nodestro_files" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND id = %(id)s

chunks_count.text: SELECT count(*) FROM "nodestro_chunks" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s

chunks_sources.text: SELECT DISTINCT source FROM "nodestro_chunks" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s ORDER BY source

chunks_insert.text: INSERT INTO "nodestro_chunks" (tenant_id, namespace, source, title, file_id, metadata, text, search_text) VALUES (%(tenant_id)s, %(namespace)s, %(source)s, %(title)s, %(file_id)s, %(metadata)s::jsonb, %(text)s, %(search_text)s) RETURNING id

chunks_delete_source.text: DELETE FROM "nodestro_chunks" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND source = %(source)s

chunks_max_id.text: SELECT coalesce(max(id), 0) FROM "nodestro_chunks" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s

chunks_missing_up_to.text: SELECT c.id, c.text FROM "nodestro_chunks" c WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND c.namespace = %(namespace)s AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "nodestro_chunk_vectors" v WHERE v.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND v.space = %(space)s AND v.chunk_id = c.id) AND c.id <= %(high)s ORDER BY c.id LIMIT %(limit)s

chunks_missing.text: SELECT c.id, c.text FROM "nodestro_chunks" c WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND c.namespace = %(namespace)s AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "nodestro_chunk_vectors" v WHERE v.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND v.space = %(space)s AND v.chunk_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT %(limit)s

chunks_count_missing.text: SELECT count(*) FROM "nodestro_chunks" c WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND c.namespace = %(namespace)s AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "nodestro_chunk_vectors" v WHERE v.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND v.space = %(space)s AND v.chunk_id = c.id)

spaces_lock_shared.text: SELECT space FROM "nodestro_vector_spaces" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s ORDER BY space FOR SHARE

spaces_lock_exclusive.text: SELECT space FROM "nodestro_vector_spaces" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s ORDER BY space FOR UPDATE

spaces_by_state.text: SELECT space, identity::text FROM "nodestro_vector_spaces" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND state = %(state)s

spaces_insert_active.text: INSERT INTO "nodestro_vector_spaces" (tenant_id, namespace, space, identity, dimensions, state) VALUES (%(tenant_id)s, %(namespace)s, %(space)s, %(identity)s::jsonb, %(dimensions)s, 'active')

spaces_insert_building.text: INSERT INTO "nodestro_vector_spaces" (tenant_id, namespace, space, identity, dimensions, state) VALUES (%(tenant_id)s, %(namespace)s, %(space)s, %(identity)s::jsonb, %(dimensions)s, 'building') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, namespace, space) DO NOTHING

spaces_activate.text: UPDATE "nodestro_vector_spaces" SET state = 'active' WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND space = %(space)s

spaces_delete.text: DELETE FROM "nodestro_vector_spaces" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND space = %(space)s

spaces_delete_others.text: DELETE FROM "nodestro_vector_spaces" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND space <> %(space)s

spaces_delete_all.text: DELETE FROM "nodestro_vector_spaces" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s

vectors_insert.text: INSERT INTO "nodestro_chunk_vectors" (tenant_id, namespace, space, chunk_id, embedding) VALUES (%(tenant_id)s, %(namespace)s, %(space)s, %(chunk_id)s, %(embedding)s)

vectors_store.text: INSERT INTO "nodestro_chunk_vectors" (tenant_id, namespace, space, chunk_id, embedding) SELECT c.tenant_id, c.namespace, %(space)s, c.id, %(embedding)s FROM "nodestro_chunks" c WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND c.namespace = %(namespace)s AND c.id = %(chunk_id)s ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, space, chunk_id) DO UPDATE SET embedding = excluded.embedding

vectors_count.text: SELECT count(*) FROM "nodestro_chunk_vectors" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND space = %(space)s

vectors_count_excluded.text: SELECT count(*) FROM "nodestro_chunk_vectors" v WHERE v.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND v.namespace = %(namespace)s AND v.space = %(space)s AND NOT (NOT (v.embedding && '{NaN,Infinity,-Infinity}'::real[]) AND v.embedding <> array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[cardinality(v.embedding)]))

search_fts.text: SELECT id, source, title, file_id, metadata::text, text FROM "nodestro_chunks", to_tsquery('simple', %(query)s) AS query WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND search @@ query ORDER BY ts_rank(search, query, 1) DESC, id LIMIT %(limit)s

search_fts_sources.text: SELECT id, source, title, file_id, metadata::text, text FROM "nodestro_chunks", to_tsquery('simple', %(query)s) AS query WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND search @@ query AND source = ANY(%(sources)s) ORDER BY ts_rank(search, query, 1) DESC, id LIMIT %(limit)s

search_pgvector.text: SELECT c.id, c.source, c.title, c.file_id, c.metadata::text, c.text, round((1 - (v.embedding::vector <=> %(vector)s::vector))::numeric, 6)::float8 AS score FROM "nodestro_chunk_vectors" v JOIN "nodestro_chunks" c ON c.id = v.chunk_id WHERE v.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND v.space = %(space)s AND c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND c.namespace = %(namespace)s AND NOT (v.embedding && '{NaN,Infinity,-Infinity}'::real[]) AND v.embedding <> array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[cardinality(v.embedding)]) ORDER BY score DESC, c.id LIMIT %(limit)s

search_pgvector_sources.text: SELECT c.id, c.source, c.title, c.file_id, c.metadata::text, c.text, round((1 - (v.embedding::vector <=> %(vector)s::vector))::numeric, 6)::float8 AS score FROM "nodestro_chunk_vectors" v JOIN "nodestro_chunks" c ON c.id = v.chunk_id WHERE v.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND v.space = %(space)s AND c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND c.namespace = %(namespace)s AND c.source = ANY(%(sources)s) AND NOT (v.embedding && '{NaN,Infinity,-Infinity}'::real[]) AND v.embedding <> array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[cardinality(v.embedding)]) ORDER BY score DESC, c.id LIMIT %(limit)s

search_candidates.text: SELECT c.id, v.embedding FROM "nodestro_chunk_vectors" v JOIN "nodestro_chunks" c ON c.id = v.chunk_id WHERE v.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND v.space = %(space)s AND c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND c.namespace = %(namespace)s AND NOT (v.embedding && '{NaN,Infinity,-Infinity}'::real[]) AND v.embedding <> array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[cardinality(v.embedding)])

search_candidates_sources.text: SELECT c.id, v.embedding FROM "nodestro_chunk_vectors" v JOIN "nodestro_chunks" c ON c.id = v.chunk_id WHERE v.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND v.space = %(space)s AND c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND c.namespace = %(namespace)s AND c.source = ANY(%(sources)s) AND NOT (v.embedding && '{NaN,Infinity,-Infinity}'::real[]) AND v.embedding <> array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[cardinality(v.embedding)])

search_hits.text: SELECT id, source, title, file_id, metadata::text, text FROM "nodestro_chunks" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND id = ANY(%(ids)s)

search_word_counts.text: SELECT t.w, (SELECT count(*) FROM "nodestro_chunks" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND search @@ to_tsquery('simple', t.q)) FROM unnest(%(words)s::text[], %(queries)s::text[]) AS t(w, q)

search_word_hits.text: SELECT c.id, t.w FROM "nodestro_chunks" c, unnest(%(words)s::text[], %(queries)s::text[]) AS t(w, q) WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND c.namespace = %(namespace)s AND c.id = ANY(%(ids)s) AND c.search @@ to_tsquery('simple', t.q)

memory_read.text: SELECT content FROM "nodestro_memory_files" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND path = %(path)s

memory_write.text: INSERT INTO "nodestro_memory_files" (tenant_id, namespace, path, content) VALUES (%(tenant_id)s, %(namespace)s, %(path)s, %(content)s) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, namespace, path) DO UPDATE SET content = excluded.content, updated_at = clock_timestamp()

memory_files.text: SELECT path, octet_length(content) FROM "nodestro_memory_files" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND starts_with(path, %(start)s)

memory_delete.text: DELETE FROM "nodestro_memory_files" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND (path = %(path)s OR starts_with(path, %(under)s))

memory_rename.text: UPDATE "nodestro_memory_files" SET path = %(new)s || substr(path, %(cut)s), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s AND (path = %(old)s OR starts_with(path, %(under)s))

memory_clear.text: DELETE FROM "nodestro_memory_files" WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s AND namespace = %(namespace)s
